label: Galaxy Tab S9 tablet
description: Android tablet with an optional 5G sub-6 GHz modem and Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, HE160, 1024-QAM) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO at up to 2.4 Gbps.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E — Samsung lists 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax on 2.4/5/6 GHz, HE160, MIMO, 1024-QAM. Cellular (5G SKU SM-X716B): 5G sub-6 GHz only, no mmWave; LTE Cat 20 fallback. USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 with full DeX, so a dock gives a wired interface (usb0) alongside Wi-Fi — the canonical 'tablet docked on a desk while still on Wi-Fi' model.
